counting_note: Five papers, three data products and one existing system. Access and licence documents are grouped with their corresponding data products.

sources.label: Source 1
sources.title: Conflating point of interest (POI) data: A systematic review of matching methods
supports: POI matching workflow and similarity measures
Established related work rather than algorithmic novelty

sources.label: Source 2
sources.title: POI point entity matching and fusion based on multi similarity calculation
sources.venue: ISPRS Annals of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences
supports: Combining name, address and spatial similarities
AHP weighting precedent, not justification for untested local weights

sources.label: Source 3
sources.title: Point-of-interest (POI) data validation methods: An urban case study
supports: Singapore validation comparison and effects of matching choices
sources.access_note: Publisher content was returned by search; later direct fetch returned HTTP 429.

sources.label: Source 4
sources.title: Quality assessment of OpenStreetMap's points of interest with large-scale real data
supports: Completeness varies by POI category and context
External surveyed-reference study differs from this small consistency sample

sources.label: Source 5
sources.title: Evaluation of the resilience of the catering industry in Hong Kong before and after the COVID-19 outbreak based on point-of-interest data
supports: Resilience analysis differs from branch matching and field agreement

sources.label: Source 6
sources.author: Food and Environmental Hygiene Department
sources.title: Restaurant licences
supports: Licence and district interpretation; not ratings, reviews or live opening status

sources.label: Source 7
sources.author: OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.title: OpenStreetMap data and Overpass API
sources.licence: ODbL for map data; documentation has its own licence

sources.label: Source 8
sources.author: Overture Maps Foundation
sources.title: Places guide and place schema
supports: Existence confidence differs from accuracy and freshness
Restaurant government-data matching is established prior art

sources.label: Source 9
sources.author: whubsch
sources.title: Overmatch
sources.licence: MIT for the software; not a replacement licence for underlying data
supports: Existing OSM/Overture amenity matching and difference-review interface
Limits the originality claim for a matching tool or comparison display
sources.verification_scope: Repository README and licence inspected; software not independently executed or benchmarked.

novelty_statement: No exact FEHD-OpenStreetMap-Overture Hong Kong branch-level evaluation was identified in the targeted sources and queries recorded in literature_audit.md. This is not proof of absence or a first-ever claim.
